analysis:
Examined docs/reference/configuration.md. The range map is complete. The only changes are the last-updated date (head line 3) and a clarifying sentence on MLX_QUANTIZED_CONSTANT_CACHE (base/head line 593). The new sentence states that bf16 GPT-OSS checkpoints keep bf16 activations, so this constant-widening cache does not apply to them. That is a performance and numerics documentation note about a bounded in-process constant cache. It is not a prompt or KV cache.

The change does not alter the SSD prefix-cache gates, TTL, encryption, or the LaunchAgent allow-list. It also leaves attestation, App Attest, logout and endpoint-resumption semantics unchanged. Relevant threats are T-041 (prefix cache, unchanged), TB-007 and T-027 (model execution integrity). Neither is affected, since the change is documentation only.

The surrounding unchanged base text (SSD prefix cache table, base lines 497-552) is consistent with T-041's mitigations: the 1800 s TTL can only shorten, the kill switch and the disk budget match. No regression and no threat-model gap was identified. The accuracy of the bf16 claim against ConstantArrayCastCache.swift was not verifiable from the supplied evidence and is not security-relevant.
